fullTextEN: Would you still decide to get pregnant and have a child?
I really thought about this question.
I think I would still have a child.

fullTextZH: 因为生孩子只是很短的时间嘛
fullTextEN: Because having a child is just a short time.

fullTextZH: 你和孩子在一起的幸福的时间很长
fullTextEN: The happy time with your child is long.

fullTextZH: 我也是我有一样的想法
fullTextEN: Me too, I have the same thought.

fullTextZH: 然后我甚至和我老公说
fullTextEN: Then I even told my husband.

fullTextZH: 不管以后我们会发生什么
fullTextEN: No matter what happens to us in the future,
Or I might really hate you.

fullTextZH: 或者发生很多不好的事情
fullTextEN: Or many bad things might happen.

fullTextZH: 可是我还是会决定和你结婚生孩子
fullTextEN: But I would still decide to marry you and have children.

fullTextZH: 因为我太喜欢我的女儿了
fullTextEN: Because I really love my daughter.

fullTextZH: 我还是会跟你这个人生孩子
fullTextEN: I would still have children with you in this life.

fullTextZH: 对因为和别人生不出这个孩子
fullTextEN: Yes, because I can't have this child with someone else.

fullTextZH: 是的所以他是一个非常重要的工具
fullTextEN: Yes, so he is a very important tool.

fullTextZH: 他是一个我们很重要的产品
fullTextEN: He is a very important product of ours.

fullTextZH: 还没有发生我担心的事情
fullTextEN: The things I worry about haven't happened yet.

fullTextZH: 然后我觉得看他每天都不一样
fullTextEN: And I feel he looks different every day.

fullTextZH: 怎么会有这么神奇的事情
fullTextEN: How can there be such a magical thing?

fullTextZH: 觉得这个生命就是很有意思
fullTextEN: I think this life is very interesting.

fullTextZH: 他怎么越来越像一个人了
fullTextEN: How does he become more and more like a person?

fullTextZH: 那sasa你会考虑生第二个孩子吗
fullTextEN: So Sasa, would you consider having a second child?

fullTextZH: 我想先知道你想不想生第二个孩子
fullTextEN: I want to know first if you want to have a second child.

fullTextZH: 如果我可以生一个一岁以后的孩子
fullTextEN: If I could have a child older than one year,
He immediately becomes older than one year,

fullTextZH: 其实很多人觉得我生孩子不太容易
fullTextEN: Actually, many people think it's not easy for me to have children.

fullTextZH: 你肯定不想生第二个孩子
fullTextEN: You definitely don't want to have a second child.

fullTextZH: 可能等我这个儿子长大一点
fullTextEN: Maybe when my son grows up a bit.
Maybe it still depends on the situation.
